msg: The file is not parseable JSON, so no validator can read it
fix: Fix the JSON syntax first; OSCAL tooling stops at the parser.
An OSCAL SSP document has exactly one root object key: system-security-plan.
metadata, import-profile, system-characteristics, system-implementation and control-implementation are all required.
metadata needs title, last-modified, version and oscal-version.
OSCAL dateTime-with-timezone requires a trailing Z or +HH:MM, e.g. 2026-09-17T09:00:00-04:00.

msg: Value is not an RFC 4122 version 4 or 5 UUID
fix: Generate a real v4 uuid; the OSCAL uuid datatype pins the version nibble to 4 or 5.

msg: Reference points at a uuid that is not defined in this file
fix: Define the component, party or user it names, or correct the reference.

msg: control-id is not in OSCAL lower-dotted form
fix: Write ac-2.1, not AC-2(1); OSCAL control ids are lowercase and use a dot for the enhancement.

msg: security-sensitivity-level is outside the FIPS 199 vocabulary
security-impact-level is incomplete or outside the FIPS 199 vocabulary
fix: All three objectives (confidentiality, integrity, availability) are required, each fips-199-low/moderate/high.
Add a props entry named implementation-status with implemented, partial, planned, alternative or not-applicable.
A planned control needs a planned-completion-date prop and a matching POA&M item.
Close the control or move the date and update the POA&M before the package is read.

msg: Placeholder text left in prose a reviewer reads
fix: Replace TBD/TODO/Lorem ipsum/<insert with the real narrative.

msg: metadata.last-modified is more than 365 days old
fix: Continuous monitoring expects the SSP to be reviewed and re-stamped each year.
The OSCAL 1.1 line is current; re-state oscal-version once the document is migrated.
